thingsToDo.title: Banyan Tree Park
thingsToDo.description: Banyan Tree Park is a town square park in or near Lahaina, Hawaii. Banyan Tree Park in Lahaina centers on a large Indian banyan tree planted in 1873 to commemorate the fiftieth anniversary of the first American Protestant mission. The site has long functioned as a civic gathering space in downtown Lahaina. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation.

thingsToDo.title: Lahaina Historic District
thingsToDo.description: Lahaina Historic District is a historic district in or near Lahaina, Hawaii. Lahaina Historic District is a National Historic Landmark district that preserves former capital-era buildings, mission sites, and waterfront streetscapes. The district reflects Lahaina's roles in Hawaiian monarchy history, Pacific whaling, and missionary-era urban development. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation. Its present-day access and management context shape how residents and visitors use the area.

thingsToDo.title: Waiola Church
thingsToDo.description: Waiola Church is a historic church in or near Lahaina, Hawaii. Waiola Church in Lahaina was founded in the 1820s and became a central congregation in Maui's early mission period. The church and adjacent cemetery are historically linked to Hawaiian aliʻi burials and nineteenth-century religious transitions. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation. Its present-day access and management context shape how residents and visitors use the area.

thingsToDo.title: Old Lahaina Courthouse
thingsToDo.description: Old Lahaina Courthouse is a historic courthouse museum in or near Lahaina, Hawaii. Old Lahaina Courthouse, completed in 1860, served judicial and customs functions during the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi period. The building later housed heritage institutions and remained a key civic structure in Lahaina's waterfront historic core. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation. Its present-day access and management context shape how residents and visitors use the area.

thingsToDo.title: Mokuʻula
thingsToDo.description: Mokuʻula is a historic cultural site in or near Lahaina, Hawaii. Mokuʻula in Lahaina was a sacred island complex and royal residence area associated with Kamehameha III and earlier aliʻi traditions. The site remains an important cultural restoration focus tied to wetlands, spring systems, and Hawaiian governance history. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for Lahaina?
faq.a: Two to three days is enough for core Lahaina highlights plus one or two local experiences.

faq.q: Should I book tours ahead in Lahaina?
faq.a: Yes—advance booking is recommended for weekends, holidays, and top-rated operators.
